message:
## Vulnerability Digest

This DLL component scan used only `DLL_software_component.txt`; duplicate names and version variants were normalized within that file. The scan window was **2026-10-02 13:10 IST through 2026-10-03 13:10 IST** (2026-10-02 07:40 through 2026-10-03 07:40 UTC).

**21 newly surfaced, relevant vulnerabilities were confirmed.** All affect the monitored Bouncy Castle C# component: `BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1`. The vendor lists BC C# .NET 2.6.2 and earlier as affected and 2.7.0 as fixed. Vendor pages were posted October 1, while the CVE/NVD and GitHub-advisory records surfaced during this scan window; they are included on that basis.

The vendor advisories reviewed do not state severity ratings, so severity is recorded as **not clearly stated** rather than inferred.

### Findings
**Finding 1: CVE-2026-103600 - ASN.1 parser recursion denial of service**

- **Affected component:** BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1 / BC C# .NET
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the vendor advisory
- **Description and relevance:** Deeply nested ASN.1 can exhaust the stack and terminate a process; the monitored 1.8.1 version is within the vendor's affected range.
- **Source:** [Bouncy Castle vendor advisory](https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp/wiki/CVE-2026-103600)

**Finding 2: CVE-2026-103601 - CCM/KCCM releases plaintext before tag validation**

- **Affected component:** BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1 / BC C# .NET
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the vendor advisory
- **Description and relevance:** Failed decryption can leave unverified plaintext in caller buffers and expose it through reuse or logging; 1.8.1 is affected.
- **Source:** [Bouncy Castle vendor advisory](https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp/wiki/CVE-2026-103601)

**Finding 3: CVE-2026-103602 - PKIX name-constraint bypass via trailing dot**

- **Affected component:** BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1 / BC C# .NET
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the vendor advisory
- **Description and relevance:** Certificate names ending in a root-label dot can evade excluded email, DNS, or URI subtrees during path validation; 1.8.1 is affected.
- **Source:** [Bouncy Castle vendor advisory](https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp/wiki/CVE-2026-103602)

**Finding 4: CVE-2026-103603 - HSS/LMS oversized allocation denial of service**

- **Affected component:** BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1 / BC C# .NET
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the vendor advisory
- **Description and relevance:** A crafted HSS public key and signature can cause extremely large memory allocation during verification; 1.8.1 is affected.
- **Source:** [Bouncy Castle vendor advisory](https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp/wiki/CVE-2026-103603)

**Finding 5: CVE-2026-103604 - Quadratic X.509 name escaping denial of service**

- **Affected component:** BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1 / BC C# .NET
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the vendor advisory
- **Description and relevance:** Long distinguished-name values can drive CPU exhaustion when converted or compared; 1.8.1 is affected.
- **Source:** [Bouncy Castle vendor advisory](https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp/wiki/CVE-2026-103604)

**Finding 6: CVE-2026-15999 - AES-CCM authentication-tag length validation failure**

- **Affected component:** BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1 / BC C# .NET
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the vendor advisory
- **Description and relevance:** A zero or very short attacker-controlled tag length can remove or weaken integrity checks during decryption; 1.8.1 is affected.
- **Source:** [Bouncy Castle vendor advisory](https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp/wiki/CVE-2026-15999)

**Finding 7: CVE-2026-16000 - KCCM tag omits nonce and length without associated data**

- **Affected component:** BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1 / BC C# .NET
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the vendor advisory
- **Description and relevance:** Applications using KCcmBlockCipher directly without associated data can accept forged ciphertexts; 1.8.1 is affected.
- **Source:** [Bouncy Castle vendor advisory](https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp/wiki/CVE-2026-16000)

**Finding 8: CVE-2026-16001 - IesEngine stream-mode MAC-key exposure**

- **Affected component:** BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1 / BC C# .NET
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the vendor advisory
- **Description and relevance:** Known plaintext can reveal the MAC key for shorter messages and enable forgery when IesEngine is used directly in stream mode; 1.8.1 is affected.
- **Source:** [Bouncy Castle vendor advisory](https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp/wiki/CVE-2026-16001)

**Finding 9: CVE-2026-63566 - DTLS fragment memory exhaustion**

- **Affected component:** BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1 / BC C# .NET
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the vendor advisory
- **Description and relevance:** A small unauthenticated datagram can force large handshake reassembly allocations; 1.8.1 is affected.
- **Source:** [Bouncy Castle vendor advisory](https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp/wiki/CVE-2026-63566)

**Finding 10: CVE-2026-63567 - IES/ECIES padding oracle**

- **Affected component:** BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1 / BC C# .NET
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the vendor advisory
- **Description and relevance:** Block-cipher IesEngine decryption can reveal padding-versus-MAC failures and permit captured-message plaintext recovery; 1.8.1 is affected.
- **Source:** [Bouncy Castle vendor advisory](https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp/wiki/CVE-2026-63567)

**Finding 11: CVE-2026-63568 - CMP/CRMF password-MAC iteration denial of service**

- **Affected component:** BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1 / BC C# .NET
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the vendor advisory
- **Description and relevance:** Untrusted messages can select excessive PBM iteration counts and consume CPU before authentication; 1.8.1 is affected.
- **Source:** [Bouncy Castle vendor advisory](https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp/wiki/CVE-2026-63568)

**Finding 12: CVE-2026-63569 - DHAgreement peer ephemeral-value validation failure**

- **Affected component:** BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1 / BC C# .NET
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the vendor advisory
- **Description and relevance:** Direct DHAgreement use can accept malicious peer values that force known shared secrets or leak static-key information; 1.8.1 is affected.
- **Source:** [Bouncy Castle vendor advisory](https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp/wiki/CVE-2026-63569)

**Finding 13: CVE-2026-63570 - PKCS#12 certificate-chain infinite loop**

- **Affected component:** BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1 / BC C# .NET
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the vendor advisory
- **Description and relevance:** Mutually referring certificates can make GetCertificateChain consume CPU and memory until failure; 1.8.1 is affected.
- **Source:** [Bouncy Castle vendor advisory](https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp/wiki/CVE-2026-63570)

**Finding 14: CVE-2026-63571 - X.509 attribute-certificate signature not verified**

- **Affected component:** BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1 / BC C# .NET
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the vendor advisory
- **Description and relevance:** The validator can accept forged attribute certificates that name a trusted authority, enabling privilege escalation in affected applications; 1.8.1 is affected.
- **Source:** [Bouncy Castle vendor advisory](https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp/wiki/CVE-2026-63571)

**Finding 15: CVE-2026-63572 - PKCS#12 excessive-iteration denial of service**

- **Affected component:** BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1 / BC C# .NET
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the vendor advisory
- **Description and relevance:** Untrusted PFX files can choose very large KDF iteration counts and tie up worker threads; 1.8.1 is affected.
- **Source:** [Bouncy Castle vendor advisory](https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp/wiki/CVE-2026-63572)

**Finding 16: CVE-2026-63573 - CMS RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 Bleichenbacher oracle**

- **Affected component:** BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1 / BC C# .NET
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the vendor advisory
- **Description and relevance:** Distinguishable key-unwrapping failures can disclose content-encryption keys after many chosen-ciphertext requests; 1.8.1 is affected.
- **Source:** [Bouncy Castle vendor advisory](https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp/wiki/CVE-2026-63573)

**Finding 17: CVE-2026-63574 - OpenPGP subpacket excessive allocation**

- **Affected component:** BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1 / BC C# .NET
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the vendor advisory
- **Description and relevance:** A few header bytes can request an allocation approaching 2 GB before signature verification; 1.8.1 is affected.
- **Source:** [Bouncy Castle vendor advisory](https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp/wiki/CVE-2026-63574)

**Finding 18: CVE-2026-63575 - PKCS#12 non-positive iteration-count denial of service**

- **Affected component:** BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1 / BC C# .NET
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the vendor advisory
- **Description and relevance:** Zero or negative counts can trigger roughly 2^32 KDF iterations for untrusted PFX or encrypted keys; 1.8.1 is affected.
- **Source:** [Bouncy Castle vendor advisory](https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp/wiki/CVE-2026-63575)

**Finding 19: CVE-2026-63576 - URI name-constraint bypass**

- **Affected component:** BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1 / BC C# .NET
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the vendor advisory
- **Description and relevance:** Incorrect URI host extraction can allow certificates outside permitted subtrees or inside excluded subtrees; 1.8.1 is affected.
- **Source:** [Bouncy Castle vendor advisory](https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp/wiki/CVE-2026-63576)

**Finding 20: CVE-2026-63577 - directoryName permitted-subtree bypass**

- **Affected component:** BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1 / BC C# .NET
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the vendor advisory
- **Description and relevance:** Non-prefix RDN matching can accept certificate names outside a constrained CA's permitted namespace; 1.8.1 is affected.
- **Source:** [Bouncy Castle vendor advisory](https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp/wiki/CVE-2026-63577)

**Finding 21: CVE-2026-63578 - Encrypted-private-key excessive-iteration denial of service**

- **Affected component:** BouncyCastle.Crypto 1.8.1 / BC C# .NET
- **Severity:** Not clearly stated in the vendor advisory
- **Description and relevance:** Untrusted PKCS#8 or CMS password-recipient parameters can force prolonged KDF work; 1.8.1 is affected.
- **Source:** [Bouncy Castle vendor advisory](https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp/wiki/CVE-2026-63578)
### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes operators, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector/SQL Interface, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, MongoDB-owned alerts, GitHub advisories, NVD/CVE-oriented records, and CISA sources.

No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported or materially updated within the exact 24-hour window. Older MongoDB advisories were excluded.

### Review priority

Immediate review is recommended because the monitored Bouncy Castle version is explicitly inside the affected range for all 21 findings, including certificate-validation bypasses, cryptographic integrity failures, padding oracles, and multiple unauthenticated denial-of-service paths. The common vendor-fixed release is BC C# .NET 2.7.0; validate package compatibility and deployment exposure before changing production systems.
